# LEIPING · Software Matrix & Product Architecture

> Canonical Developer Hub: https://leiping.dev

LEIPING 专注于本地优先安全、深度语言认知、一页纸交互学习、诗画古诗文研习与 AI 伴读的独立开发与系统架构。

## Products Portfolio

- **拾页 (Shiye)**: https://shiye.leiping.dev
  - Description: 家长为孩子生成的一页互动学习手账。提炼教材考点与认知线索，一键排版 A4 纸张手账，免登录分享链接交付孩子端沉浸作答。
  - Platforms: Web (Next.js 14), iOS App.

- **青简 (Qingjian)**: https://qingjian.leiping.dev
  - Description: 面向中小学生与古诗文爱好者的诗画卡牌研习空间。对开册页诗卡、统一宋代院体绢本淡彩插画，免登录即启日课，字解声韵真背成诵。
  - Platforms: Web (Next.js 16), PWA (离线研习).

- **WordHub**: https://wordhub.top
  - Description: 全面的英语与语言深度学习平台。以词源学 (Etymology) 和 WordNet 认知网络为基石，结合语境记忆法与跨设备无缝同步。
  - Platforms: Web, macOS (SwiftUI), iOS, Browser Extension (WXT).

- **TOTPBOX**: https://www.totpbox.com
  - Description: 本地优先的双因素认证助手与 Passkey 伴侣。零知识架构，全本地 AES-256-GCM 强加密保险库，拒绝主密码上云泄露，极速自动填充并平滑升级通行密钥。
  - Platforms: Chrome / Edge MV3 Extension, Web.

- **CogniSphere**: https://cognisphere.leiping.dev
  - Description: 常驻浏览器侧边栏的智能阅读辅助。划词即解、全页提炼研读，支持 BYOK (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama) 及 Chrome 内置端侧本地大模型。
  - Platforms: Chrome, Edge, Firefox Extension, Web.

## Architecture
- All products are developed and maintained independently by LEIPING.
- All product nodes are interconnected via bidirectional canonical dofollow links.
